verdict.line: You lose if you trade into his W/E dashes up or get caught near a wall after level 6; you win if you poke pre-6 with Q/W and use R to ground his mobility.

brief.thesis: K'Sante has no sustained ranged pressure and both his engage/escape tools, W (Path Maker) and E (Ce N'est Pas), are long-cooldown dashes that are down more often than they're up before level 6, so Camille can freely poke with Q (Precision Protocol) and W (Tactical Sweep) edge without a real punish. After 6, his R (All Out) turns a wall-adjacent trade into a stun-into-burst kill combo, but Camille's own R (The Hextech Ultimatum) directly counters his dash-reliant kit by grounding him inside the pull zone. This is a matchup won or lost by whether you track his dash cooldowns and passive stack count precisely, not by raw stats.

theirWindow.when: W and E both up, you're near a wall
theirWindow.what: He can chain Path Maker into Ce N'est Pas to knock you into a wall for a stun, then dump his full combo plus a 3-stack passive proc for a knock-up. Disengage with E (Hookshot) to a different wall or hold Flash rather than trading here.

yourWindow.when: Both his dashes down, passive stacks low
yourWindow.what: Walk up and poke freely with Q-AA-Q or a W edge hit; he has no engage or escape tool until W/E come off cooldown, so he has to eat the trade.

start.why: Presses your pre-6 poke advantage with extra trade damage and sustain through his Q auto-shred pokes.

boots.why: Cuts down the auto-attack damage from his passive procs and his full-combo all-in once he closes distance.

core.why: Core damage and mobility spike; the empowered auto after Q lets you burst through his shield window before his passive maxes stacks.
Stacking armor shred lets your true-damage Q and autos keep cutting through his tank build, plus the slow helps you land poke.
Converts burst into damage-over-time so you survive the delayed payoff of his wall-stun combo instead of getting deleted in one window.

situational.when: he's ahead and threatening to one-shot you out of his All Out combo
he's won a skirmish or two and you need to reset the trade cycle without giving up tempo
his passive proc and combo burst is chunking you harder than expected in extended trades

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the extended poke-and-skirmish pattern this lane wants; stacks build during your safe pre-6 trades and carry into all-in windows.

summoners.why: Teleport resets your poke cycle and returns you to lane after punishing his all-in; Flash both dodges his wall-stun setup and lets you threaten kill angles once you have R.

playing.title: Poke with Q before he can respond
playing.detail: Q-AA-Q whenever his W and E are both on cooldown; the true damage on the second hit adds up fast and he has no ranged answer.

playing.title: Track his passive stack count
playing.detail: Don't extend a trade once he's at 2/3 Dauntless Instinct stacks; the third auto knocks you up and deals bonus damage on top of his combo.

playing.title: Only all-in with both dashes down
playing.detail: Check whether W (Path Maker) or E (Ce N'est Pas) was used recently before committing; either one live gives him an escape or a wall-stun engage.

playing.title: Avoid wall-adjacent trades pre-6 and post-6
playing.detail: His combo payoff is a knockback into a wall; fight in open lane space where he can't chain W into E for the stun.

playing.title: Use R to ground his dashes
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum's zone stops him from escaping via W/E; save it for when he mispositions on your side of the wave rather than as a follow-up tool.

playing.title: Deny his ability-combo window
playing.detail: If he lands one ability, expect the second within a couple seconds for his combo bonus; back off after eating the first hit instead of standing for both.

playing.title: Respect his scaling past 14
playing.detail: Once he has a full tank build and All Out up, don't solo duel him; play for picks with R and group for objectives instead.

brief.patchCaveat: Item names, rune names, and K'Sante's exact ability values may have drifted since training data (knowledge cutoff January 2026); confirm current tooltips in champ select before finalizing runes and build order.
